admin.control.emergencyHint: An emergency stop takes effect when apps recheck the policy after publishing. Immediate stopping is not guaranteed.
admin.control.featureHint: Feature toggles only turn implemented capabilities on or off. They never grant new capabilities.
admin.current.source: Loaded from policy.json at the deployment root.
admin.events.noSecrets: Keys, raw QR contents, room codes, and hub addresses are never put in the event list.
admin.export.blocked: The policy must pass validation before it can be exported.
admin.export.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text below and copy it manually.
admin.export.notPublished: Downloading or copying is not publishing.
admin.feature.rememberPersonalKey: Remember personal key in the browser
admin.field.allowDirectSubscription: Allow control-only joining from direct mode
admin.field.allowedHubIds: Allowed hub IDs (registered in code only)
admin.field.emergencyReason: Stop reason (three languages, up to 300 characters)
admin.field.label: Display label (three languages)
admin.import.invalidJson: The JSON could not be parsed.
admin.import.loaded: The imported policy was loaded into the editor. It is not applied as the live policy.
admin.import.sameValidator: Imported JSON is checked with the same validator the app uses.
admin.import.tooLarge: Cannot import: the JSON exceeds 64 KiB.
admin.issue.POLICY_CONFLICT: Policy items conflict. Example: the default is outside the allowed values, or the source and target languages are the same.
admin.issue.POLICY_RANGE: The value is outside the allowed range or step.
admin.issue.POLICY_REFERENCE: References an unregistered setting, feature, hub, or provider.
admin.issue.POLICY_SCHEMA: Unsupported schema version. Only v1 is accepted.
admin.issue.POLICY_TEXT: A three-language text is missing, empty, or too long.
admin.issue.POLICY_UNKNOWN_KEY: Contains a key that is not allowed. External URLs, HTML, scripts, API keys, and room codes are rejected.
admin.noSecrets: This console has no login, password, token, or deployment call. Keys and payloads are never placed in the policy JSON, storage, or logs.
admin.notApplied: The policy being edited is not applied as this app's live policy.
admin.notSecurityBoundary: The policy governs a normal app. It is not a security boundary against modified clients or copied keys.
admin.payload.cleared: The input and result were cleared.
admin.payload.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link below and copy it manually.
admin.payload.expiresAfterEvent: The expiry cannot be later than the event end.
admin.payload.key: Shared API key (kept in memory only)
admin.payload.memoryOnly: The entered key and result are cleared on close or when leaving the page. The app's saved keys are never read.
admin.payload.noActiveEvent: There is no active event. Enable an event and publish it first.
admin.payload.noAutoNavigate: The link is never opened automatically. Copy or download it, then place it in a QR tool.
admin.payload.noQr: Dynamic QR image generation is not supported.
admin.payload.separate: This tool is separate from the policy editor. The key is never included in the policy JSON.
admin.payload.tooLong: The link exceeds the length limit. Check the event name or key.
admin.preview.noBase: There is no current policy to compare with. Load the current policy first.
admin.preview.noChanges: Nothing differs from the current policy.
admin.preview.revisionRequired: When the content changes, the revision must be higher than the current one. The app rejects different content with the same revision.
admin.preview.stopsWork: Locks and feature stops end affected tasks that are in progress.
admin.preview.title: Change preview
admin.pricing.empty: The rate table is empty. Do not enter arbitrary amounts before verification.
admin.pricing.estimateOnly: Rates are operator-verified per-minute estimates, not Google's official prices. They are always shown as estimates.
admin.publish.keyRevoke: Revoke keys in the provider console.
admin.publish.noConfirmation: This console never shows publishing as complete. Deployment is confirmed only when the reloaded policy shows a new revision.
admin.publish.propagation: Because of static CDN refresh, offline use, and background tabs, changes do not reach every phone immediately.
admin.publish.rollback: To roll back, publish the previous content as a new revision instead of lowering the revision.
admin.publish.step1: Download or copy the policy JSON.
admin.publish.step2: Replace policy.json at the repository's deployment root with the new content.
admin.publish.step3: Commit and deploy after code review. Publishing authority is the repository and deployment right.
admin.publish.step4: Reload the current policy in the app and confirm that the revision changed.
admin.publish.title: Publishing steps
admin.scope: Editing, validating, and downloading are not administrative privileges. Repository commit and deployment rights are the actual publishing authority.
admin.settings.lockedHint: Locking forces the default. A single allowed value is shown as effectively locked.
admin.title: Policy administrator console
admin.validation.none: No issues found. The policy can be exported.
admin.validation.title: Validation results
app.name: Interpreter
audio.description: The defaults reduce background music and noise so that only human speech is sent. Changes apply at the next start.
audio.noiseSuppressionHelp: Asks the browser for noise suppression, echo cancellation, automatic gain and voice isolation. What is actually applied depends on the device and browser.
audio.sensitivityHelp: Low sends quiet sound as silence so music and noise matter less; high keeps even a quiet speaker.
audio.voiceFilterHelp: Reduces bass and treble outside 80 Hz to 8 kHz to limit the effect of music and noise.
billing.byCapability: Usage time by capability and model
billing.displayOnly: The plan selection changes only what is displayed. API permissions, actual charges, quotas, and retry budgets do not change.
billing.estimate.partial: Estimate for the segments that could be calculated
billing.estimateAlways: This value is always an estimate. It is calculated with operator-verified estimated rates, not Google’s official prices converted to a per-minute price.
billing.formula: Estimated cost = active usage time per segment ÷ 60 × estimated rate per minute
billing.hubExcluded: Venue broadcast listening is not your own Gemini call, so no cost is calculated for it.
billing.keyChanged: The key changed. Check the plan display again.
billing.localRateHint: You can enter a personal rate only when the site policy allows it. Even then it is shown only as an estimate.
billing.mayDiffer: It may differ from the actual plan of your Google project.
billing.noDoubleCount: Reconnects and duplicate stops never count time twice.
billing.notZero: Unknown costs are never shown as 0.
billing.paidShowsCost: Paid shows usage time and the estimated cost, along with the calculation scope, rate source, and verification date.
billing.perProvider: The plan display is saved per provider.
billing.rateFixed: When the rate table changes, earlier usage segments keep the rate that applied at the time.
billing.rateMissingHint: Models without a set or verified rate are not estimated. No arbitrary amount is used.
billing.rateSource.personal: Personal setting (when the policy allows it)
billing.sharedExcluded: Personal key usage and venue shared-key usage are not added together.
billing.title: Plan and usage
billing.tokenNotIncluded: Token-based calculation of actual charges is not included.
billing.usageHint: Active usage time observed in this run. It is not the billing history of your whole Google project.
captionOnly.title: Captions-only screen
captionOnly.wakeLock.failed: Could not keep the screen on. Check the screen timeout in your device settings.
captionOnly.wakeLock.unsupported: This browser cannot keep the screen on. Extend the screen timeout in your device settings.
device.deviceSpeechSystemOutput: Device speech uses the system output.
device.disappeared: The selected device disappeared, so the system default is used again.
device.inputAppliesNextStart: Changing the input device ends the current recording or direct interpretation and applies from the next start.
device.labelsAfterPermission: Device names appear after microphone permission is allowed. They are not guessed before that.
device.listIncomplete: Because of browser and permission limits, the list may be incomplete.
device.localOnly: Device IDs are stored only on this device and are never put in policies, logs, or diagnostics exports.
device.outputPcmOnly: The output device selection applies to interpreted speech playback.
device.outputPermission: Choosing an output device may need browser permission. It is requested when you press the button.
device.outputUnsupported: This browser does not support choosing an output device. The system output is used.
diagnostics.connectionOnly: A successful connection alone does not verify interpretation quality or audible output.
diagnostics.delayedMs: Time with speech queue wait over 3 seconds (ms)
diagnostics.liveScope: The Live test is a short connection test for the selected provider, model, and key source. Voice tests and hub reception are separate results.
diagnostics.metricsPrivacy: Default measurements exclude keys, room codes, source text, translations, and original audio.
diagnostics.policyBudget: Queue warnings and limits are app policies, not end-to-end latency guarantees.
diagnostics.scope: Results apply only to the selected provider, key source, and capability.
diagnostics.speechEndToFirstAudioMs: Speech end → first audio received (ms, estimated; negative means before end)
diagnostics.speechToFirstAudioMs: Speech onset → first audio received (ms, estimated)
diagnostics.timingBoundary: Audio scheduling and device speech start events are not physical first sound. Measure actual listening latency separately.
diagnostics.title: Connection diagnostics
diagnostics.ttsFirstRequestMs: Time to first device speech request (ms)
diagnostics.ttsFirstStartMs: Time to first device speech start event (ms)
diagnostics.userStart: Press the button to start voice diagnostics.
display.captions.hint: Caption size is applied on top of the overall text size. It is used on the simultaneous caption board.
display.monoHint: Monochrome high contrast suits very bright or dark places such as outdoors or lecture halls.
display.savedOnDevice: Display settings are saved only on this device.
display.systemHint: Follow system uses your device’s light or dark setting.
display.textHint: Text size applies to the whole screen. Button touch areas do not shrink.
display.title: Display settings
error.APP_VERSION_TOO_OLD: This app version is too old to start interpretation. Update the app, then start again.
error.BROWSER_INTERRUPTED: Interpretation stopped when the app left the foreground. Tap to resume.
error.BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: The automatic attempt limit was reached. Check before retrying manually.
error.BUDGET_REQUIRED: The task could not be completed. Check settings and retry.
error.CAPABILITY_UNIMPLEMENTED: This capability is not ready yet.
error.CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED: The selected provider does not support this capability.
error.CREDENTIAL_FORBIDDEN: This key cannot be used on this connection path.
error.CREDENTIAL_MISMATCH: The selected key changed. Restart with the current settings.
error.CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED: Enter a key for the selected provider and mode.
error.DAILY_LIMIT: The translation quota is exhausted. New interpretation is unavailable; existing content remains visible.
error.DUPLICATE_PROVIDER: The task could not be completed. Check settings and retry.
error.EVENT_ENDED: The event you joined has ended or been stopped. Shared use has ended.
error.HUB_CONTROL_LOST: The venue control connection could not be confirmed, so the event session was stopped.
error.HUB_CONTROL_STOPPED: Venue staff stopped interpretation. Wait for the release notice.
error.HUB_REQUIRED: This capability requires a venue hub.
error.INVALID_KEY: The key is invalid. Check key settings.
error.INVALID_PROVIDER: The task could not be completed. Check settings and retry.
error.INVALID_REQUEST: The task could not be completed. Check settings and retry.
error.INVALID_RESULT: The interpretation result could not be validated. Please retry.
error.INVALID_SHARED_PAYLOAD: Shared key information is invalid. Ask the administrator for a new QR code.
error.IP_DENIED: Check that you are using the permitted venue network.
error.LIVE_CONNECTION_FAILED: Live connection failed. Run connection diagnostics.
error.MICROPHONE_DENIED: Microphone access was denied. Check permission or enter text.
error.MICROPHONE_UNAVAILABLE: The microphone is unavailable. Check the input device or enter text.
error.MODEL_UNSUPPORTED: This model is unavailable. Run connection diagnostics.
error.PERMISSION_DENIED: Check the key or API permissions.
error.POLICY_EXPIRED: The site policy has expired. New interpretation cannot start until a new policy is published.
error.POLICY_FEATURE_DISABLED: The administrator has turned this feature off.
error.POLICY_LOADING: Checking the site policy. You can start once the check finishes.
error.POLICY_STOPPED: The administrator issued an emergency stop. Interpretation cannot start until it is lifted.
error.POLICY_UNAVAILABLE: The site policy could not be verified, so interpretation cannot start. Check your network, then press Check again.
error.PROVIDER_ERROR: The task could not be completed. Check settings and retry.
error.SAFETY_BLOCKED: The provider declined this content. It will not be retried automatically.
error.SECURITY_ERROR: The key could not be handled safely. Check settings.
error.SESSION_LIMIT: The concurrent session limit was reached. Check that the previous connection has closed.
error.SETTINGS_UNSUPPORTED: These settings are unsupported. Check settings.
error.STORAGE_FAILED: The key could not be saved to or read from device storage. Private browsing or low storage space may be the cause. Turn saving off to use the key for this run only.
error.STORE_CLOSED: The key store has closed. Reopen the app.
error.TIMEOUT: The response timed out. Please retry.
error.TOKEN_LIMIT: The request or session processing limit was reached.
error.UNAVAILABLE: The interpretation service is busy. Try again later.
error.UNKNOWN_429: Requests are limited, but the cause and reset time are unknown. Automatic repetition has stopped.
error.UNKNOWN_PROVIDER: The task could not be completed. Check settings and retry.
error.URL_CLEANUP_FAILED: Startup stopped because the shared link could not be handled safely.
error.VOICE_FAILED: Translation is complete, but speech failed. Use device speech or captions.
error.unknown: The task could not be completed. Check settings and retry.
event.applies: Event list changes, expiry, and stops also apply to the shared key currently in use.
event.enabledNote: Enabled is the operator's declaration of permission, not proof that IP restrictions were verified.
event.idNotSignature: The event ID is not a signature and does not prove the administrator's identity.
event.name: Event name
event.noLive: An event policy alone does not enable shared-key simultaneous interpretation.
event.none: There are no events to join right now.
event.payloadMismatch: This shared key does not match the current event list. Ask the administrator for a new QR code.
event.title: Venue shared-key events
hub.accessDenied: You cannot join this room. Check venue instructions.
hub.broadcastError: Listening stopped due to a broadcast error. Check with venue staff.
hub.deviceSpeech: Venue speech reads final translated captions using device speech.
hub.languageRemoved: Listening stopped because the selected language is unavailable. Select a target language again.
hub.languageUnavailable: No supported broadcast language is available.
hub.noKeyOrMicrophone: Listening to the venue broadcast requires no microphone or API key.
hub.recentNotice: Recent captions may appear when joining. Captions received before turning sound on are not read automatically.
hub.resumeSound: Sound is off after reconnecting. Turn sound on to hear new captions.
hub.timeLimit: The broadcast ended at its time limit.
hubControl.controlOnly: A control-only connection does not start the microphone, API key use, or caption reading.
hubControl.lost: Venue control connection cannot be confirmed
hubControl.releaseOnly: A stop is lifted only by a newer notice from venue staff. It is not lifted automatically when the connection drops.
hubControl.scope: Venue control applies only to devices that joined this event.
hubControl.title: Venue live control
hubControl.unsupportedHint: This hub does not support live control. Listening can continue.
keyGuide.clearedAfterSave: After saving, the input is cleared and returns to hidden.
keyGuide.createLink: Google AI Studio API key page
keyGuide.emptyDirect: Interpreting with your phone microphone needs a personal key. Follow the steps below to create one and enter it in Settings.
keyGuide.freeNote: Creating a key is free, and you can get started without setting up billing. Free access and limits vary by model.
keyGuide.noRefill: A saved key is never filled back into the input. To change it, enter a new key.
keyGuide.notAllFree: A free key does not mean every interpretation model can be used for free. Check Google’s free and paid tiers and their limits.
keyGuide.restriction: Check that the key is restricted to the Gemini API only.
keyGuide.restrictionWhy: According to Google’s guidance, unrestricted standard keys may be rejected and keys are moving to a new key type. This is something to check after creating the key, not an optional extra.
keyGuide.saved.browser: The key was saved in this browser
keyGuide.saved.failed: The key could not be saved. The saved key was not changed.
keyGuide.saved.session: The key is used for this run only
keyGuide.sharedNotShown: Shared keys are never shown or saved on this device.
keyGuide.showHint: Showing applies only to the key you are typing now. Keep it hidden when other people are nearby.
keyGuide.step3: Copy the key and paste it here
keyGuide.title: How to get a Gemini API key
keyGuide.usageLink: Google’s guide to using API keys
mode.changed: The active task ended because settings changed.
notice.accuracy: Interpretation may contain errors. Verify important details against the original.
notice.data: Text and audio are sent to the selected provider, even when history saving is off.
notice.eligibility: Provider conditions must be checked for region, age, and personal or shared use. Eligibility has not been confirmed for everyone.
notice.microphonePermission: Allow microphone access in browser settings to use speech. Text works without a microphone.
notice.wifi: Check the venue Wi-Fi and administrator instructions.
permission.busyHint: Another app or tab is using the microphone. Close it and try again. This is not a permission denial.
permission.gestureOnly: Permission is requested only when you save settings for direct interpretation or press Start. The app cannot allow it by itself or undo a denial.
permission.help.android: Android Chrome: allow the microphone under Permissions in the site information next to the address bar, or check app permissions in Android Settings.
permission.help.desktop: Desktop: allow the microphone in the site permissions from the address bar, and check your OS privacy settings for the browser’s microphone access.
permission.help.ios: iOS Safari: allow the microphone in the site settings from the address bar, and also check Safari and Privacy in the iOS Settings app.
permission.help.menuVaries: Exact menu names depend on the device and version.
permission.help.title: If permission was denied
permission.noAutoRetry: After a denial the app does not ask again automatically. Allow it in browser settings, then try again.
permission.noDeviceHint: No microphone is connected. Connect a device and try again.
permission.notEvidence: Past use is not evidence of the current permission. The actual status is checked each time.
permission.notNeededHere: The language, display and share buttons, venue broadcast listening, and the administrator console never request microphone permission.
permission.title: Microphone permission
permission.unsupportedHint: This browser cannot report permission status. The result of an actual request is used instead.
policy.blocked.noAutoStart: Interpretation does not start automatically when restrictions are lifted. Press Start.
policy.blocked.persistent: Reasons that block interpretation are not cleared automatically.
policy.blocked.title: Interpretation cannot start
policy.blocked.updateHint: You can update from the App section in Settings.
policy.changed.display: The administrator changed display settings. Your connection is kept.
policy.changed.pricing: Rates were updated. New rates apply from the next usage segment.
policy.changed.reopened: The administrator widened the allowed range. You can start again with the Start button.
policy.changed.stopped: The active task ended because the site policy changed.
policy.description: The site policy governs how this app behaves. Revoking a key is done in the provider console.
policy.lock.forced: This value is set by the administrator and cannot be changed.
policy.lock.label: Locked by the administrator
policy.lock.restored: The administrator restriction was lifted, and your previous choice was restored.
policy.lock.restricted: Only items allowed by the administrator can be selected.
policy.lock.singleOption: Only one option is allowed, so it cannot be changed.
policy.lock.uiLanguage: The display language cannot be locked by the administrator. Korean, English, and Japanese are always available.
policy.notPersisted: The policy body is not stored on the device.
policy.notice.empty: There are no notices right now.
policy.notice.title: Administrator notices
policy.propagation: With static hosting, offline use, or background tabs, a new policy may not apply immediately.
policy.staleHint: If a recheck fails, the last verified policy is kept for up to 5 minutes.
policy.title: Site policy
providers.geminiTerms: Review Gemini’s free-service data terms. Check the applicable terms before entering sensitive conversations.

pwa.closeOtherTabs: The app is open in another tab. Close the other tabs, then update.
pwa.installPrompt: Add to your home screen for easy access next time.
pwa.installUnavailable: The install button is unavailable here. You can continue in the browser.
pwa.iosInstall: In Safari, open Share and select “Add to Home Screen”.
pwa.nameLanguage: Changing the display language may not immediately change the installed app name.
pwa.offline: You can view existing content offline, but new interpretation needs an internet connection.
pwa.updateAvailable: An update is available. Finish the active interpretation before updating.

quota.project: Gemini limits apply per project. Changing keys does not reset limits.
quota.resetUnknown: The exact reset time is unknown.
quota.title: Usage and limits
quota.unknown: The key alone cannot establish billing status or remaining project quota.
records.clearConfirm: Clear all current originals and translations?
records.memory: The current conversation is kept only in memory and disappears when the page closes.
records.sharedEnded: Shared use ended; the key and current conversation were cleared.

seq.recordingLimit: You can record up to {seconds} seconds at a time.

settings.keyDeleted: The key was deleted from this device.
settings.keyMemory: By default, keys are kept only for the current app run.
settings.keyRestriction: Restrict your personal key to the Gemini API.
settings.keyRetentionHint: On iPhone and iPad, the home-screen app and Safari keep separate storage, and the browser may delete a stored key after seven days without use. If the header shows "No key", enter the key again on this phone.

settings.keySavedSession: Kept for this run only — enter it again after reloading
settings.keyStorageWarning: Browser storage is not an encrypted vault. Do not save keys on shared devices.
settings.modeExplicit: Choose personal or shared keys explicitly; they never switch automatically.
settings.rememberKey: Remember personal key on this device
settings.rememberWarning: Uncheck on shared devices. Browser storage is not an encrypted vault.

settings.sectionHint.billing: The plan selection sets how usage is displayed and does not change your Google billing settings.
settings.sectionHint.diagnostics: Test the connection for the selected provider, key, and capability, and check the venue hub status.

settings.sharedTemporary: Shared keys are temporary and are not saved on the device.

sim.gap.input: Some microphone input was not sent.
sim.gap.reception: Some content may have been missed during the connection.

sim.sourceAuto: The source language is detected automatically.
